SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS average_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS average_balance
FROM account AS a
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount >= 2400
  AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency
ORDER BY average_balance DESC
LIMIT 10;
